race.description: Mcgrath Real Estate Super Mdn Hcp
race.comment: PULSATOR (9) is a first starter by Snitzel from Heart Of Thrills who has been a fine producer including winners at black type level. Was in the placings in his most recent trial at Randwick. A product of the strong juvenile stable of Gai Waterhouse & Adrian Bott. Promising type who is sure to be highly competitive. ZYNARO (5) went forward and gave a great sight before finishing third when resuming last time out over this trip at Wyong. Will take advantage of the good draw and this looks well within his grasp. DARN YOU (12) went well on debut three-and-a-half weeks ago when fifth over 1100m at Warwick Farm. Better for the race experience and look for an improved run. ELECTRIC BLISS (13) filly by Prague from Electric Charge on debut. Ran third at a recent trial. Watch for any market confidence.
